messages:
rebecca: FYI I've sketched a short 'troubleshoot playbook' for timeouts vs context limit errors. It's lightweight—intended for support and engineering to triage quickly. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899

owen: Nice. Can you summarize the fast checks we should show first? Support likes a 3-step checklist.

rebecca: Sure — thinking: 1) check API response code + headers, 2) examine recent token histogram & peak sequence length, 3) verify client retry policy + any Retry-After. Example snippet included for header sniffing and an inlined curl.

rebecca: Curl example (for support runbook):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"small-2048","input":"..."}'
```
Look for 429 and Retry-After, 408/504 for timeouts, and 413/400 for payload/context issues.

angela: Can we avoid repeating the backoff snippets we already have in /snippets? Instead link to canonical snippets and show a condensed pseudo-code flowchart inline. Keeps page scrubby.

rebecca: Agree. I've added anchors to the canonical snippets. But there were two broken cross-doc links in the err-ref I hit while authoring—one to `troubleshooting/retries` and one to `guides/context-sizing`. I fixed them in the draft and left a note in the PR about verifying the site build resolves the anchors.

tasha: I'm going to add short SDK examples for the playbook: small Py/JS examples that show header-aware retry and a note about limiting concurrent inflight requests from browser clients. I'll mirror the code style used in redwood-py.

owen: Small ask from QA — can we include a reproducible harness snippet that simulates 100 concurrent short requests hitting a dedicated pool to verify fallback routing? Even pseudo-code is fine.

rebecca: Added a tiny Node script pseudo-harness and instructions: use `wrk` or a simple Promise.all loop. Included the routing log pattern to look for: `route.choice=smaller-variant` or `route.fallback=dedicated-burst`.

build-bot: Reminder: run CI snippet checks and internal link validation: `make docs-lint` then `make docs-validate-links`. Also run `yarn docs:snippets:lint`.

tasha: Heads-up: I'm also updating the SDK snippets repo in a separate PR (redwood/pkgs/snippets#122) to include the header-aware retry function for python and JS. Will link to it from the playbook so the docs page doesn't inline full implementations.

angela: One content note — for the decision guidance please avoid prescriptive language like "always trim prompts". We should prefer conditional recommendations and show a one-line sample decision table: when tokens >> model window -> trim or switch model; when intermittent 429s -> backoff + retry-after; when sustained capacity issues -> route to dedicated or reduce concurrency.

rebecca: Done, I rewrote the tone and added a small example UX message for product teams: "We're sorry — context too long; try reducing recent messages or choose a shorter response."

nowen: I'll run the smoke harness tomorrow and post logs. If the link validator flags anything, ping me and I'll help fix anchors.

rebecca: Plan: merge doc PR after snippet PR lands and CI passes. Target end of week. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
